title: Eval-lane evidence bundle (check #10)
description: Documentation of the bundle that evaluation/check10-evidence.mjs independently recomputes. The checker has no live-count literal: it derives the expected tool prefix from the repo's mcp.json, recomputes every hash from the bytes at the returned path, and compares the runner (checks.py) against the frozen manifest. A missing bundle fails the check.

mcp-calls.jsonl.description: One JSON object per line, in call order. seq must be a dense increasing sequence from 1. tool must start with mcp_<server>_ where <server> is the first key in the repo's mcp.json. Each record that returns an artifact must name resultPath (absolute, or bundle-relative) and resultSha256 (the hash of the bytes at that path).

resultPath.description: The path the tool returned. The checker hashes the bytes there; nothing is trusted.

artifact-hashes.json.description: The artifact table: every artifact returned by a call, and only those. Accepted shapes: {"artifacts":[{"path","sha256"}]}, {"artifacts":{<path>:<sha256>}}, or a bare {<path>:<sha256>} map. Paths must resolve to the same artifacts the calls returned (bijection). No numeric field whose name matches /count|total|artifacts|entries|calls/i may disagree with the recomputed call/artifact counts.

checks.py.description: The eval lane's own runner. It must answer `python3 checks.py --list-checks --json` with {"checks":[{"id":<int|string>,"command":<string>}]}. The checker requires the id set to equal the frozen manifest's check ids and every command string to match the manifest exactly, so a lane cannot measure itself against a different bar.

run.json.description: Optional run record. Any numeric count field it declares must match the recomputed counts.
